compute: All API observation processing, inference, scoring and planning on dislab; local display/transport only

api.request_budget_scope: explicit small trial budget, not assertion of provider quota; 401/403/429 stop immediately;3consecutive transport failures stop

clock: Calibrate remote native clock to collecting computer by midpoint SSH roundtrip. Record offset/uncertainty; monotonic UTC anchor thereafter. Same clock for capture, issue and truth. Abort initialization if uncertainty>2seconds.

model.weather: existing archived features with original lag/missing masks; do not claim live weather
model.first_issue: Missing previous snapshot explicitly masked; later issues use preceding10min snapshot. Do not invent a previous observation.

score.target: separately captured future API displayed stock
score.scope: small live diagnostic only; no new independent model superiority or latent-demand/relocation effect

serving.planning: Observation-time shadow plan only, not actual dispatch. Matching input version required. Unchanged H17 finite candidate optimizer; no claimed current-driving ETA.
serving.ui: Latest observation/forecast target/last score and explicit source time, no hypotheses. Update data display from private local transport. Preserve old recorded view until live forecast exists.

success: At least1causal issued-before-truth scored roundtrip plus all engineering acceptancechecks pass; service may continue bounded24h, no field/model superiority inference
failure: Preserve auth/network/schema/lateissue/clock/hash failures; no fabricated snapshots or future backdating
stop: 24hours or143stationrequests orauth/ratelimit or3consecutiveAPIerrors, whicheverfirst. No reboot persistence or quota escalation.
